behavior: Explicit new numeric point inputs use constructor word 0x100; no raw inner point coordinate default is inferred.
New lines require a caller-bound six-value scene snapshot. Finite Float32 carriers are established before bounds comparisons.
Any axis inversion, lower bound at negative maximum Float32, or upper bound at positive maximum Float32 selects the origin-to-10 mm X seed.
A valid zero X span does not select that fallback; the strict virtual setter leaves cleared start, direction and length.
Typed endpoint writes follow command seeding. Rejected candidates retain the seed, and cached Apply does not reevaluate it.
Existing-object edits must keep their saved prior geometry/state rather than use new-object initialization.
